topics.topic: Segment structure change bringing commercial Microsoft 365 revenue together in Productivity and Business Processes
topics.stated_position: Management says it "brought revenue from the commercial components of Microsoft 365 together" in the PBP segment "to align to how the business is managed," pulling in EMS and Power BI per-user revenue previously reported in Azure within Intelligent Cloud and Windows Commercial products and cloud services revenue previously reported in Windows within More Personal Computing.
topics.quote: We have brought revenue from the commercial components of Microsoft 365 together in the Productivity and Business Processes (“PBP”) segment to align to how the business is managed.

topics.topic: Elevation of cloud revenue growth metrics to KPIs
topics.stated_position: Management elevated cloud revenue growth metrics for Microsoft 365 Commercial, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Dynamics 365, and Azure to KPI status, replacing the former "products and cloud services" KPIs, stating that "This elevation aligns to our strategic focus on cloud growth."
topics.quote: We elevated our cloud revenue growth metrics for Microsoft 365 Commercial, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Dynamics 365, and Azure to be KPIs, which have replaced the former “products and cloud services” KPIs. This elevation aligns to our strategic focus on cloud growth.

topics.topic: Redefinition of the Azure metric around consumption
topics.stated_position: With EMS and Power BI per-user revenue moved out, management states the "Azure metric now more closely aligns to consumption business."
topics.quote: With EMS revenue and Power BI per-user revenue moved into Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud metric, Azure metric now more closely aligns to consumption business

topics.stated_position: Windows revenue (now excluding Windows Commercial) and Devices revenue will be reported together "to bring revenue from PC market-driven businesses together," with the separate Windows OEM and Devices growth metrics replaced by a single "Windows OEM and Devices revenue growth" metric "to align to how the PC market-driven businesses are managed."
topics.quote: Windows revenue (now excluding Windows Commercial revenue as noted above) and Devices revenue will now be reported together in SEC filings to bring revenue from PC market-driven businesses together

topics.topic: Copilot Pro reclassification and renaming of Office Consumer
topics.stated_position: Copilot Pro revenue moved from Office Consumer products and cloud services in PBP to Search and news advertising in MPC "to align to how the business is managed," and "Office Consumer products and cloud services" was renamed "Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services" "given the current branding of the product."
topics.quote: Copilot Pro revenue has moved from Office Consumer products and cloud services in our PBP segment to Search and news advertising in our MPC segment to align to how the business is managed. We then renamed “Office Consumer products and cloud services” to “Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services” given the current branding of the product.

topics.topic: Nuance revenue reclassification between Intelligent Cloud and Productivity and Business Processes
topics.stated_position: Nuance Enterprise revenue moved from Server products and cloud services in Intelligent Cloud to Dynamics products and cloud services in PBP, while "Nuance Healthcare revenue remains in Server products and cloud services," with management stating "These changes better align to how the businesses are managed."
topics.quote: Nuance Enterprise revenue has moved from Server products and cloud services in the IC segment to Dynamics products and cloud services in the PBP segment. Nuance Healthcare revenue remains in Server products and cloud services. These changes better align to how the businesses are managed.

topics.topic: Purpose of Microsoft's supplemental disclosure framework
topics.stated_position: Management frames its supplemental disclosure as intended to "Enable investors to evaluate progress against our ambitions," "Provide transparency into performance trends," and "Reflect the continued evolution of our products and services."
topics.quote: Enable investors to evaluate progress against our ambitions Provide transparency into performance trends Reflect the continued evolution of our products and services

notable_language.quote: This elevation aligns to our strategic focus on cloud growth.
notable_language.why_notable: An explicit statement of strategic priority attached to a reporting change — management names cloud growth as the strategic focus driving which metrics become KPIs.

notable_language.quote: to align to how the business is managed
notable_language.why_notable: A phrase that recurs across nearly every segment and metric change in this presentation (Microsoft 365 Commercial, Copilot Pro, Nuance, Windows/Devices), functioning as the standing justification for restructuring disclosure.

notable_language.quote: Momentum and innovation from a product, customer, and partner perspective
notable_language.why_notable: Self-characterisation of the narrative the disclosure framework is meant to convey — 'momentum and innovation' as the framing lens for investor communications.

notable_language.quote: We will report our FY25 Q1 results in the structure discussed on the prior slides. Therefore, we have provided mechanical updates only to our outlook as provided on July 30, 2024 for the changes discussed in this presentation.
notable_language.why_notable: An unusually explicit hedge insisting the restated outlook reflects no change in underlying expectations — only 'mechanical updates' — pre-empting any read of the restructuring as a guidance revision.
